title: How to Contact Facebook Support [2019] Save Hours & Headaches
description: What's up all!  If you're like me, you hate spinning your wheels looking for support online. I spent a few hours trying to access Facebook Support to help resolve an issue for a client.  It's obvious that Facebook wants to drive you to their support articles, which are sometime convoluted and do not help at all. Sometimes, you just need to speak (or at least chat) with a human.  Ultimately, I found out how to access Facebook Support, so I figured I would pass along that knowledge to everyone on YouTube.  Try going here from your FB account first to see if this opens up an immediate chat with Facebook support: https://www.messenger.com/t/facebookadsupport   If that doesn't work, follow the steps outlined in the video, but first, click the link below to start:  https://www.facebook.com/business/help  If you found this helpful, please leave a LIKE, Subscribe, and comment.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents an instructional walkthrough for reaching Facebook Business support through an advertising-support topic, issue categories, and a Start Chat option. The flow leads to a Messenger conversation labeled Facebook Advertiser Support, consistent with ordinary customer support. Requests for likes, subscriptions, and comments are audience engagement and are not presented as conditions for receiving support.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The video is an operational tutorial showing how to navigate Facebook Business Help, select an advertising-support topic, and reach the chat option.
